```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
library(plotly)
library(dplyr)
library(DT)
library(jsonlite)
library(stringi)

title_font <- list(family = "Outfit, sans-serif", size = 13, color = "#1a1a1a")

fi_dark <- "#101622"

data <- readRDS("asukasluku-kunnat.rds")
data$Municipality <- as.character(data$Municipality)

# Finnish-locale alphabetical order (Å, Ä, Ö sort after Z)
munis <- stri_sort(unique(data$Municipality), locale = "fi_FI")
groups <- c("All", munis)

pop_by_group <- lapply(groups, function(g) {
  d <- if (g == "All") {
    data |> group_by(Year) |> summarise(Count = sum(Count), .groups = "drop")
  } else {
    data |> filter(Municipality == g) |> select(Year, Count)
  }
  d |> arrange(Year)
})

# Pre-compute the full per-municipality trace data
line_group_data <- lapply(seq_along(groups), function(i) {
  d <- pop_by_group[[i]]
  pad <- (max(d$Count) - min(d$Count)) * 0.1
  if (pad == 0) pad <- max(d$Count) * 0.05

  list(
    x = I(d$Year),
    y = I(d$Count),
    hovertext = I(paste0("<b>", d$Year, "</b><br>Population: <b>",
                          formatC(round(d$Count), big.mark = " ", format = "d"), "</b>")),
    yrange = I(c(min(d$Count) - pad, max(d$Count) + pad))
  )
})

filter_js <- paste0(
  "window.popData = ", as.character(jsonlite::toJSON(line_group_data, auto_unbox = TRUE)), ";\n",
  "
function popFindGraphDiv(preferredId, positionIndex) {
  var el = document.getElementById(preferredId);
  if (el && el.data) return el;

  var all = Array.prototype.slice.call(document.querySelectorAll('.js-plotly-plot'));
  var byId = all.find(function (e) { return e.id && e.id.indexOf(preferredId) !== -1; });
  if (byId) return byId;

  if (all.length > positionIndex) return all[positionIndex];
  return null;
}

function popUpdateLine(el, g) {
  if (!g || !el) return;
  Plotly.update(el, {
    x: [g.x],
    y: [g.y],
    hovertext: [g.hovertext]
  }, {
    'yaxis.range': g.yrange
  }, [0]);
}

window.popUpdateMunicipality = function (idx) {
  try {
    var g = window.popData[idx];
    var el = popFindGraphDiv('population-line', 0);
    popUpdateLine(el, g);
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('Population filter update failed:', err);
  }
};

function popInitFilter() {
  var control = document.getElementById('municipality-filter');
  if (!control || control.getAttribute('data-fi-init') === '1') return;
  control.setAttribute('data-fi-init', '1');

  var valueSpan = control.querySelector('.fi-muni-filter-value');
  var menu = control.querySelector('.fi-muni-filter-menu');
  var items = menu ? menu.querySelectorAll('.fi-muni-option') : [];
  var searchInput = control.querySelector('.fi-muni-filter-search');
  var noResults = menu ? menu.querySelector('.fi-muni-no-results') : null;

  function filterItems(query) {
    var q = query.trim().toLowerCase();
    var anyVisible = false;
    Array.prototype.forEach.call(items, function (li) {
      var text = li.textContent.toLowerCase();
      var match = q === '' || text.split(/[\\s-]+/).some(function (word) {
        return word.indexOf(q) === 0;
      });
      li.classList.toggle('is-hidden', !match);
      if (match) anyVisible = true;
    });
    if (noResults) noResults.classList.toggle('show', !anyVisible);
  }

  function resetSearch() {
    if (searchInput) searchInput.value = '';
    filterItems('');
  }

  function closeMenu() {
    control.classList.remove('open');
    control.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
    document.removeEventListener('click', onDocClick);
  }
  function openMenu() {
    control.classList.add('open');
    control.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
    document.addEventListener('click', onDocClick);
    resetSearch();
    if (searchInput) {
      setTimeout(function () { searchInput.focus(); }, 0);
    }
  }
  function onDocClick(e) {
    if (!control.contains(e.target)) closeMenu();
  }

  Array.prototype.forEach.call(items, function (li) {
    li.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
      e.stopPropagation();
      var idx = parseInt(li.getAttribute('data-index'), 10);
      valueSpan.textContent = li.textContent;
      Array.prototype.forEach.call(items, function (o) { o.classList.remove('active'); });
      li.classList.add('active');
      window.popUpdateMunicipality(idx);
      closeMenu();
    });
  });

  if (searchInput) {
    searchInput.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
      e.stopPropagation();
    });
    searchInput.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
      e.stopPropagation();
      if (e.key === 'Escape') {
        closeMenu();
        control.focus();
      } else if (e.key === 'Enter') {
        e.preventDefault();
        var firstVisible = menu.querySelector('.fi-muni-option:not(.is-hidden)');
        if (firstVisible) firstVisible.click();
      }
    });
    searchInput.addEventListener('input', function () {
      filterItems(searchInput.value);
    });
  }

  control.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
    e.stopPropagation();
    if (control.classList.contains('open')) closeMenu(); else openMenu();
  });
  control.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
    if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') {
      e.preventDefault();
      if (control.classList.contains('open')) closeMenu(); else openMenu();
    } else if (e.key === 'Escape') {
      closeMenu();
    }
  });
}
popInitFilter();
"
)
writeLines(filter_js, "population-filter.js")
```

```{r}
#| label: municipality-filter
#| output: asis
options_html <- paste0(
  '<li class="fi-muni-option', ifelse(seq_along(groups) == 1, ' active', ''),
  '" role="option" data-index="', seq_along(groups) - 1, '">', groups, '</li>',
  collapse = "\n"
)

cat(paste0(
  '<div class="fi-filter">',
  '<label class="fi-filter-label">Municipality</label>',
  '<div class="fi-muni-filter" id="municipality-filter" tabindex="0" role="button" aria-haspopup="listbox" aria-expanded="false">',
  '<span class="fi-muni-filter-value">', groups[1], '</span>',
  '<svg viewBox="0 0 10 6" class="fi-muni-filter-caret"><path d="M1 1l4 4 4-4" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg>',
  '<div class="fi-muni-filter-menu">',
  '<div class="fi-muni-filter-search-wrap">',
  '<input type="text" class="fi-muni-filter-search" placeholder="Search\u2026" autocomplete="off" aria-label="Search">',
  '</div>',
  '<ul class="fi-muni-filter-list" role="listbox">',
  options_html,
  '<li class="fi-muni-no-results">No matches</li>',
  '</ul>',
  '</div>',
  '</div>',
  '</div>',
  '<script src="population-filter.js"></script>'
))
```

## Column

### Row {height="480px"}

```{r}
#| label: population-line
initial <- pop_by_group[[1]]
initial_hover <- paste0("<b>", initial$Year, "</b><br>Population: <b>",
                         formatC(round(initial$Count), big.mark = " ", format = "d"), "</b>")
initial_yrange <- unlist(line_group_data[[1]]$yrange)

plot_ly(elementId = "population-line") |>
  add_trace(
    data = initial,
    x = ~Year,
    y = ~Count,
    type = "scatter",
    mode = "lines",
    line = list(color = fi_dark, width = 3, shape = "spline"),
    fill = "tozeroy",
    fillcolor = "rgba(255, 204, 1, 0.6)",
    hovertext = initial_hover,
    hoverinfo = "text"
  ) |>
  layout(
    title = list(
      text = "<b>Population Development</b> <span style='color:#666666;font-weight:400;'>(1990 \u2013 2025)</span>",
      font = title_font,
      x = 0
    ),
    margin = list(t = 60, pad = 8),
    showlegend = FALSE,
    dragmode = FALSE,
    hovermode = "x",
    hoverlabel = list(
      bgcolor = fi_dark,
      bordercolor = fi_dark,
      font = list(color = "#ffffff", family = "Inter, sans-serif", size = 13)
    ),
    xaxis = list(title = list(text = "Year",
                              font = list(family = "Inter, sans-serif", size = 12, color = "#555555")),
                 showgrid = FALSE, showline = FALSE, zeroline = FALSE,
                 dtick = 5,
                 tickfont = list(family = "Inter, sans-serif", size = 12),
                 fixedrange = TRUE),
    yaxis = list(title = "", showgrid = TRUE, gridcolor = "#eeeeee", showline = FALSE,
                 zeroline = FALSE, tickfont = list(family = "Inter, sans-serif", size = 13),
                 range = initial_yrange,
                 fixedrange = TRUE),
    paper_bgcolor = "white",
    plot_bgcolor = "white"
  ) |>
  config(displayModeBar = FALSE)
```
